author: Reel FX Animation
title: Reel FX hiring matte painting artists
content: Let your talent run wild! Reel FX Animation is looking for Matte Painting Artists to work on wonderful environments for our 3D feature Doctor Dolittle: King of the Wild. Maya · Nuke · Photoshop · After Effects. Montréal · 3 days/week in studio. Start date: ASAP. Apply today and show us your portfolio: https://careers.reelfx.com/apply/823?language=en

author: The Robert McLaughlin Gallery
title: RMG hiring artist for neighbourhood banner
content: Exciting news! Are you a community focused and engaged creative? We have an amazing opportunity for an artist or artist group to design a collaborative banner for The Robert McLaughlin Gallery and LivingRoom Community Art Studio's Neighbourhood Project. The selected design will be featured on a series of banners on an exterior wall of the RMG and on flags/banners for the LRCAS Mobile Art Hive Bus throughout the year. Design Proposal Submission Deadline: October 9th, 2026, 5PM. Artist(s) Selection Date: October 21, 2026. Artist(s) Fee/Commission: $2,500. Please visit the link in our bio or rmg.on.ca/opportunities for submission details. Contact: rmg.on.ca/opportunities
